trust_center.repositoryDescription: CLEATUS FedRAMP 20x Class C trust center on Paramify: certification data, deliverables, and access requests.
trust_center.accessRequestInstructions: Public deliverables download without an account. For restricted deliverables, select Request Access in the trust center and sign in. CLEATUS reviews each request in the trust center.

secure_configuration_guidance.repositoryDescription: CLEATUS Secure Configuration Guide, also published as https://trust.cleat.ai/secure-configuration-guide.json.

certified_services.serviceDescription: AI-matched federal opportunities based on the capture profile, with fit and compliance analysis

certified_services.serviceName: Opportunity Finder and Advanced Contract Search
certified_services.serviceDescription: Search and filters over SAM.gov and other public procurement sources
Agency hierarchies, contracting officers, competitor award history, forecasts and recompete scoring
Automatic shredding of the solicitation package (base, amendments, attachments) into one breakdown; document storage
Agentic proposal drafting: compliance matrices, win themes, outlines, structured volumes
Shared pipeline from capture to award, roles, notifications, activity
Partner and supplier discovery and outreach
Conversational agents that plan, reason, and execute multi-step work with the platform tools
Event-driven automations for capture and BD operations (triage, summaries, reporting, reminders)
Programmatic access to the platform for customer integrations

certified.useCase: Hosts the whole system: compute, storage, database, networking, and security services in us-gov-west-1, with us-gov-east-1 as the warm standby.

Source control, code review, and the GitHub Actions builds that publish release images to the in-boundary Amazon ECR. FedRAMP Low, below the Moderate baseline. Compensating measures: the OIDC trust is scoped to the repository; branch protection and role-based access use SSO with multi-factor authentication; the ECR repositories are immutable; images are scanned by Amazon Inspector; and production pulls only from in-boundary ECR.
Identity provider for CLEATUS staff, with enforced multi-factor authentication, and staff email and documents.
Security awareness and role-based training for CLEATUS staff. It holds no system or customer data and has no connection to the boundary.

Governance, risk, and compliance platform where CLEATUS maintains its security plan, certification package, and control evidence. It receives approved compliance evidence from in-boundary collectors and holds no customer data.
Receives one-way security and operational alerts from in-boundary monitoring through incoming webhooks. No CUI is sent.

Collects compliance evidence through a read-only cross-account audit role. FedRAMP 20x Low, below the Moderate baseline. Compensating measures: the role requires an external ID, carries only read-only audit permissions, sessions last at most one hour, and CloudTrail records every call. It holds no customer data.

nonCertified.name: Commercial Public Data Bridge (Vercel)
nonCertified.useCase: Twice-daily one-way transfer of allowlisted public procurement data from the CLEATUS commercial environment into an in-boundary S3 bucket. It carries no CUI.

nonCertified.name: Have I Been Pwned Pwned Passwords API
nonCertified.useCase: Screens new passwords against known breached passwords. Only the first five characters of the SHA-1 digest leave the boundary.

nonCertified.name: Intercom Customer Support Messaging
nonCertified.useCase: Customer support messaging widget on the sign-in page and support interface. A persistent notice prohibits CUI in the channel, each messenger open requires a recorded CUI-prohibition attestation, and file attachment, drag and drop, and file paste are blocked.

nonCertified.name: npm Registry (build-time package fetch)
nonCertified.useCase: Supplies public JavaScript packages to the image build outside the boundary, pinned by a lockfile with integrity hashes. No data is sent to it.

nonCertified.name: Stripe Payment Processing
nonCertified.useCase: Payment processing. Card data goes from the browser directly to Stripe, and CLEATUS servers handle only Stripe object identifiers and billing metadata, with CUI prohibited in that metadata. Stripe is PCI DSS Level 1 with SOC 2 Type II.

current.service_desc: CLEATUS is a cloud-based Software-as-a-Service (SaaS) platform that provides AI-powered government contracting business development and proposal support. Users discover and evaluate federal contracting opportunities, manage capture and pipeline activities, generate and refine proposal content, and automate recurring business development workflows. The system is hosted in AWS GovCloud (US), with us-gov-west-1 as the primary region and us-gov-east-1 as a warm standby, and it processes, stores, and transmits Controlled Unclassified Information (CUI) for organizations that support the Department of Defense. The system does not process classified information.
